main.description: A published TimelineJS timeline. Written by the authoring app and read by the player and embeds; this record is the durable artifact, and drafts live elsewhere. Record keys are app-generated strings rather than TIDs.

title.description: The timeline's name, for listings. Distinct from `timeline.title`, which is the title slide; this is a plain string and that is an event.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's shape. Absent means the record predates versioning, which is the only distinction it draws at version 1 — and the reason to stamp it now rather than when it is first needed.

createdAt.description: Set on every publish, so in practice this is when the record was last written rather than when the timeline was created. Named for the atproto convention it follows.

title.description: Optional title slide. Shown first and pinned there; carries no date.

events.description: The dated slides. Ordered by date at render time, not by position here.

event.description: One slide. `start_date` is required on every event except the title slide.

unique_id.description: Author-facing slide identifier, used as the anchor in deep links. Meant to stay legible, so it is editable and not a stable key: uniqueness is checked at publish rather than guaranteed by the structure.

media_position.description: Which side the media column appears on. Defaults to left.

group.description: Optional grouping label, used to band slides in the time navigation.

date.description: A variable-resolution date: supply only the precision you have. Years may fall outside the range JavaScript dates can express, so cosmological scales are representable and a negative year means BCE.

display_date.description: Replaces the rendered date string entirely. The structured fields still order the slide.

text.description: Slide prose. Both fields may carry inline HTML, sanitized on the way in.

media.description: Slide media. Either `url` for externally hosted media or `blobRef` for media uploaded to the author's repo — when a blob is present the URL is derived from it at read time and is not stored.

mimeType.description: Type hint that takes precedence over matching on the URL. Derived from the blob when one is present, so it is stored only for external media.

alt.description: Alt text for image media. Falls back to the caption when omitted.

background.description: Slide background. A color, an image, or both.

ogImage.description: Social-share preview image, generated at publish time.

settings.description: Display and playback configuration. Every field is optional; an omitted field means the player's default.

language.description: UI locale for chrome and date formatting. Currently 'en' (default) and 'es'.

theme.description: Defaults to auto, which follows the viewer's own preference.

fontPairing.description: Heading and body font pair, carried forward from TimelineJS 3. Defaults to georgia-helvetica, the only pairing built from system fonts and so the only one covering every writing system. Open rather than closed, since pairings may be added.

highContrast.description: Raises text and marks to WCAG AAA contrast. Applies over whichever theme is in effect rather than replacing it.

initialIndex.description: Zero-based index of the slide shown first, counting the title slide when there is one.

reverseOrder.description: Show events newest first. The title slide stays first regardless.
